name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) "South Eden" Plain Smashed Hamburger (Flare-Safe Mod)
whyItWorks: The gentlest burger at Laketown's Some Beaches! 1/4 lb 100% chuck smashed thin on the grill on a soft artisan bun without roughage, cheese, or harsh sauces.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the South Eden Hamburger plain on the artisan white bun with light ketchup or yellow mustard (hold lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles).
